case landed/locked-drift
inputs
  options discard-ignored=false discard-branch=false full=false
  landed <m1:id> <m1:path> remove <tip:<m1:branch>> clean 0 none
  landed <m2:id> <m2:path> remove <tip:<m2:branch>> clean 0 none
commits
  commit <member-tip> tree:61d9b03cd7a5 parents=(tree:aae8b72173c2)
  commit <member-tip> tree:aae8b72173c2 parents=(tree:cdd154d572ab)
  commit <tip:refs/heads/main> tree:61d9b03cd7a5 parents=(tree:aae8b72173c2)
refs-before
  ref <tip:<m1:branch>> <m1:branch>
  ref <tip:<m2:branch>> <m2:branch>
  ref <tip:refs/heads/main> refs/heads/main
response
  error cleanup fingerprint is stale
  stale true
  rows 2 nil=false order=prefix 2 of 2
  row <m1:path> | removed | clean | count=0 bytes=0 shown=0 truncated=false | none | <digest:unmapped1> |  | reason-code= | assignment=
  row <m2:path> | error | unknown | count=0 bytes=0 shown=0 truncated=false | none |  | cleanup fingerprint is stale | reason-code= | assignment=
after
  member m1 tree=absent ledger=absent
  member m2 tree=present ledger=active
  receipt op=worktree-clean target=<m1:path> state=complete phase=terminal action=removed recovery=none fingerprint=<digest:unmapped1> checkpoint=<digest:unmapped1> branch=<m1:branch> branch-oid=<tip:<m1:branch>> assignment=<m1:id> owner=<m1:owner> owned=true repo=<root>/.git detail=""
  ref <tip:<m2:branch>> <m2:branch>
  ref <tip:refs/heads/main> refs/heads/main
